title: Free flight of a lone species-C particle over 40 time units with specular wall reflection

claims.statement: A lone species-C particle (no other particle in the chamber) moves in a straight line at constant velocity and reflects specularly at the walls x = 0, 10 and y = 0, 10, with no measurable drag or drift. Tested at speed 3.6, duration 40 (many wall bounces). Tracker residuals from the reflected-line model have sd about 0.05 per coordinate, with no drift across four 10-unit segments.
